shots.name: The Press
shots.purpose: Hook: an expensive-looking macro of one real-feeling interaction; establishes the dot.
shots.picture: Black, then an extreme close-up of an order card at a grazing angle. A button labelled 'Place order' depresses (scale .97), resolves to a spinner, then 'Order placed' with a vermilion status dot that ignites.
shots.camera: Macro, 20 deg FOV, tilted plane for natural focus falloff, slow 4% push-in, 1 deg drift.
shots.technique: three.js + CSS3D (DOM typography), per-element depth blur

shots.name: Layers Part
shots.purpose: The interface separates into its working layers: layout, request, services, data, infrastructure.
shots.picture: Camera pulls back to a 3/4 axonometric view. Beneath the card, layers drop away in sequence. A packet leaves the dot and falls along a wire labelled POST /orders.
shots.camera: Pull back and orbit 35 deg, ease-in-out.

shots.name: The Dive
shots.purpose: Discovery: we fall through the layers after the request into a different world.
shots.picture: Camera dives with the packet through each plane, accelerating, and emerges beneath the floor grid.
shots.camera: Vertical dive, packet locked to frame centre, arrival ease-out at 120.

shots.name: Beneath
shots.purpose: The central image: a ceiling of light (the surface everyone sees) above, a vast quiet structure below.
shots.picture: Threads of requests descend from the luminous underside of the interface into a sparse field of service nodes. Our vermilion packet travels its route.
shots.camera: Slow lateral crane, 28 deg FOV, horizon at 45%.
shots.generative: optional atmosphere plate (Veo/Seedance) — not used in this cut

shots.name: Shaped and Checked
shots.purpose: Information travels a clean pipeline and is checked along the way.
shots.picture: Side-on tracking past a channel of gates. Each packet enters as a loose cluster and leaves as an aligned record; gates mark VALIDATE, ENRICH, STORE.
shots.camera: Long-lens track left to right, foreground gates defocused.

shots.name: The Worst Day
shots.purpose: Set up the payoff: a node fails and the route finds another way; complexity resolves to one line.
shots.picture: Top-down mesh with a lit route. One node dims to a dashed outline; the route redraws around it. The mesh fades and the single route straightens into one line that rises.
shots.camera: Top-down, slow rise, roll 90 deg so the line becomes horizontal.

shots.name: Both Sides — Product Engineering
shots.purpose: A real web product responding to interaction, shown with the structure beneath it.
shots.picture: Horizon at 58%. Above, the real AegisStore dashboard in a browser frame: an object is uploaded and the dialog reports which nodes hold the copies. Below the line, the same moment as structure: the upload descends to two storage nodes.
shots.technique: authentic UI capture (local AegisStore build, 4K) composited in three.js

shots.name: A Person Approves — AI & Automation
shots.purpose: AI with controls: request, context retrieval, document processing, human review, useful result.
shots.picture: An incoming request card; three context cards are retrieved along converging lines; a draft forms; a reviewer presses Approve; it is sent.
shots.camera: Lateral glide following the flow, left to right.

shots.name: An Ordinary Afternoon — Cloud & Platform
shots.purpose: Deployment pipeline, containers and observability as a calm routine.
shots.picture: The approval ring becomes a delivery loop (commit, build, test, deploy, observe). A rolling update turns containers over one by one; a calm latency trace runs beneath; the log reads 'Deployed · Tue 15:42'.
shots.camera: Push into the ring, then drift across the container grid.

shots.name: Obvious — Experience & Growth
shots.purpose: A difficult journey becomes one clear interaction.
shots.picture: The trace twists into a tangled journey of eight screens with back-tracking arrows; it untangles to three steps, then to a single screen with one clear action.
shots.camera: Static wide, then gentle push to the final screen.
shots.transition_out: the screen recedes into a browser frame

shots.name: AegisStore Keeps Serving
shots.purpose: Proof: real software survives a deliberate failure on camera.
shots.picture: Real AegisStore UI. (a) Overview, 3 of 3 nodes healthy. (b) Simulation Lab: 'Crash node' switched on for storage-node-2. (c) Node offline; object replicas show the surviving copies with matching SHA-256 and the download completes.
shots.camera: Browser frame floating in the world at 8 deg yaw; slow push; behind it the node ring loses one node.
shots.technique: authentic UI capture (local build, 4K) + three.js environment
shots.label: AEGISSTORE — DISTRIBUTED OBJECT STORE

shots.name: MODULX
shots.purpose: Proof: a shipped product site with a clear route from product to enquiry.
shots.picture: The MODULX page in a browser frame (modulx.in). Camera pushes from the headline toward the pack-size selector and 'Ask for a price'.
shots.camera: Slow push-in with 4 deg yaw change.
shots.technique: approved page capture (1440 px source; ~1.3x scale; disclosed)
shots.label: MODULX — PRODUCT & QUOTE SITE

shots.name: Everything Resolves
shots.purpose: The visual systems come together and simplify into one calm line.
shots.picture: The product frames recede; field, rings and threads converge and collapse into a single horizontal line with soft light above it.
shots.generative: optional atmosphere plate — not used in this cut

shots.name: The Dot Returns
shots.purpose: Close the loop with the opening detail.
shots.picture: On the line, the vermilion dot from the first shot glows; 'Order placed' appears faintly beside it and fades, leaving the dot.

shots.name: Reveal
shots.purpose: The dot becomes the period in the genuine wordmark; lockup held long enough to read.
shots.picture: 'cloudfire' writes on to the left of the dot; the mark draws (cloud outline, then the flame rises); descriptor IT SERVICES. Tagline: 'Products that ship.' / 'Systems that last.' Domain: cloudfireitservices.com.
shots.camera: Locked off with a 1.5% push across the hold.
shots.technique: SVG paths from components/cloudfire/Brand.tsx in DOM
